_readme: Each entry is a TYPE of job until a real project replaces it. To publish a real project: set illustrative to false, put the real photo in assets/projects/, and fill in date and result truthfully. Never mark a generated image as real.

projects.title: Small-business office network
projects.problem: Desks on a tangle of extension leads and a home router, so the internet drops whenever someone prints.
projects.solution: Every desk cabled to a labelled patch panel, one managed switch, business Wi-Fi with a separate guest network, and a drawing left with the owner.
projects.equipment: Cat6 structured cabling, 24-port managed switch, business access points
projects.result: A network the owner can explain to the next technician.
projects.alt: Patch panel and switches in a wall cabinet

projects.title: Retail shop camera system
projects.problem: Stock going missing and no way to know when or how.
projects.solution: Cameras covering the till, the door and the stockroom, thirty days of recording, and the owner watching from their phone at home.
projects.equipment: IP cameras, NVR with 30-day storage, phone app
projects.result: The owner sees the shop from anywhere.
projects.alt: Security camera on a building exterior

projects.title: New office, from boxes to working desks
projects.problem: New premises, new computers still in boxes, and staff starting Monday.
projects.solution: Computers unboxed, set up and secured, a shared printer, a router configured properly, and a backup that runs without anyone remembering to.
projects.equipment: Workstations, network printer, business router, backup drive
projects.result: Staff sat down and worked on day one.
projects.alt: Two technicians setting up computers and a router in a freshly painted office

projects.title: School computer room and staff Wi-Fi
projects.problem: A donated computer room with no network, and teachers sharing one phone hotspot.
projects.solution: Coverage across classrooms and the staff room, filtering appropriate for pupils, and a computer room that the teacher can reset in a minute.
projects.equipment: Access points, managed switch, content filter, lab imaging
projects.result: Lessons run without the teacher becoming the IT department.
projects.alt: Pupils in uniform at computers in a classroom with an access point on the wall

projects.title: Connectivity for a remote site
projects.problem: No fibre, weak mobile signal, and a business that needs to send invoices and take bookings.
projects.solution: A dish on a proper mount, clean power, and Wi-Fi that reaches the rooms.
projects.equipment: Starlink kit, roof mount, UPS, outdoor access points
projects.result: Reliable internet where there was none.
projects.alt: Satellite dish mounted on a roof

projects.title: Site office for an industrial contractor
projects.problem: Dusty, hot and off the main road, with power cuts that corrupt files.
projects.solution: Workstations with clean power, shared files that survive a power cut, and a support line that answers.
projects.equipment: Workstations, UPS units, shared storage, remote support
projects.result: Paperwork done on site, not driven to town.
projects.alt: An administrator in a safety vest at a two-screen workstation in a site office
